title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-04-09
source: Source:  Unknown Taper+Equipment>MA>Cass(Unk); Conversion: NAK Dragon>Cass>WAV>FLAC; FLAC encoding via TLH

ai_review.summary: A powerful Dead performance, but the acoustic portion is hampered by audible tape warble.
ai_review.review: The electric set shines with crisp energy while the acoustic set suffers from a distracting tape wobble that makes it hard to enjoy. Reviewers praise the band's sheer power and recommend listening despite the imperfect source. Recording quality is uneven – decent on the electric side but noticeably flawed on the acoustic portion.

ai_rating.rationale: Show receives high praise (5‑star review) for its energy, yet both reviewers note tape imperfections; weighted assessment yields a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape warble on the acoustic set makes it difficult to listen; electric portion sounds clearer, but overall recording is imperfect and exhibits typical analog tape artifacts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on flow; reviewers focus on overall band power rather than individual song sequencing.
